QuestInfo.name: Commanders of the Stronghold
QuestInfo.0: You searched the Square and the Power Plant in Verne Mine, but you found nothing of note. Try investigating the command rooms.
QuestInfo.1: There's a dangerous energy coming from Eleanor's room. Try investigating #bFrancis's room for now#k. #bFrancis's room#k is in #b#m310050000##k.
QuestInfo.2: Francis's Diary contained a full account of the formation of the Black Wings, and even a picture of their commander. However, you know there were originally 2 Wing Masters. They were twins, but only Orchid is in the picture. Where could Lotus be?

0.0: I have found nothing in my search of the Verne Mine Power Plant and nearby areas. None of the officers seem to know anything about the top commander. I am displeased.

yes.0: There is a terrible energy coming from Eleanor's room. I shall check the other rooms first. Francis's Room in #m310050000# seems clear, so I will head there next.

no.0: The Black Wings have become quite a thorn in my side. I must not allow this to continue.

1.0: I hate reading through such ridiculous scibblings as a diary, but I have learned more about the Wing Master leading the Black Wings. This is progress...distasteful though it was.

yes.0: Wait a minute... #p2159323# and Lotus... The twin Wing Masters. Why is only #p2159323# in the picture?

default.0: I did not fully investigate Francis's Room. Perhaps I overlooked something...I should return.
